criteria.text: Every named Q12 capture, projection, barrier, and restore-compare surface is audited for PostgreSQL name-versus-text set-operation coercion, with findings recorded in a tracked report.

A default unit guard anchors all four source-manifest composite identity unions as text, and a disposable PostgreSQL 17.10 test proves a function identity longer than 63 bytes survives unchanged in owners, ACLs, and comments.
No unaffected SQL is changed; focused tests, formatting, lint, pnpm type-check, pnpm build, and the local graph refresh pass.
